sections.h2: Will I Lose SEO Rankings When Migrating My Website?

paragraphs.text: Will I lose SEO rankings when migrating my website? Not if the move is planned properly. Rankings drop after a migration when old URLs disappear without redirects, content is left behind, internal links break, or tracking is lost. Each of these is preventable.

SEO-safe website migration means every old URL that earns traffic or links points to the right new page, every important piece of content is carried over, and Google is told about the change. A short dip of a few days is normal while Google re-crawls, but a well-run move should recover quickly and often improves performance.

sections.h2: What Website Migration Services Does Teknoppy Offer?

items.title: Website Platform Migration
items.html: Website platform migration moves your site from one system to another, for example from an old custom build or site builder to a modern CMS. Our CMS migration services include content mapping, automated import scripts, design rebuild where needed and full checking of every page.

items.title: Drupal to Modern CMS Migration
items.text: Drupal to modern CMS migration suits organisations running older Drupal versions that have become costly to secure and update. We move content, users, media and URLs to a simpler, supported platform chosen during discovery.

items.title: Joomla Migration Services
items.text: Joomla migration services help businesses leave ageing Joomla sites that rely on unsupported extensions. Articles, categories, menus and media are mapped to the new system, with redirects for every old URL.

items.title: Domain and Hosting Migration
items.text: Domain and hosting migration covers changing your domain name, merging several domains into one, or moving to a faster or more secure host. Website server migration includes files, databases, email records, security certificates and scheduled tasks.

items.title: HTTP to HTTPS Migration
items.text: HTTP to HTTPS migration moves every page to a secure connection, updates internal links and resources, and redirects old addresses. Browsers stop showing "Not secure" warnings, and visitors trust your forms and checkout.

items.title: URL Structure Migration
items.text: URL structure migration changes how your addresses are organised, for example moving from long, dated URLs to short, descriptive ones. Every old address is redirected to its new equivalent. Internal links are updated to the new addresses too, so visitors and search engines never pass through unnecessary redirect chains.

paragraphs.html: For WordPress host or server moves, see our WordPress migration page. For online store moves, see our ecommerce redesign and migration page.

paragraphs.text: Typical projects include companies moving from a slow site builder to a faster CMS, firms merging several regional websites into one domain, businesses leaving an old Joomla or Drupal install, brands changing their domain name after a rebrand, and sites moving from shared hosting to a managed cloud server. Each has different risks, so the plan always starts with a full audit.

sections.h2: How We Protect Rankings During a Move

paragraphs.text: Our website migration services follow a fixed method, refined across many site launches.
Before anything changes, we crawl the full site, record every URL, title, heading and internal link, and export traffic, rankings and backlink data. This is the baseline we measure against.
Every old URL is matched to its closest new page in a redirect map. Pages with traffic or backlinks are checked by hand, not only by script.
The new site is built and tested on a private staging address, with redirects, forms, tracking and page speed checked before launch.

paragraphs.lead: Google Search Console change of address:
paragraphs.text: When the domain changes, we use Google Search Console's Change of Address tool, submit new sitemaps and confirm ownership of both domains.
For at least four weeks after launch, we track crawl errors, indexing, rankings, traffic and leads, and fix any issue within days.

Zero downtime website migration means visitors never see an error page during the switch. We prepare the new site in full, lower DNS cache times in advance, switch over during your quietest hours and keep the old server running until the new one is confirmed stable.
Every project also includes a migration rollback plan. If a serious problem appears after launch, we can return to the previous site quickly while it is fixed, so your business is never stuck.

paragraphs.text: How long does a website migration take? Typical totals are 1 to 2 weeks for a hosting or HTTPS move, 3 to 5 weeks for a small platform change, and 6 to 8 weeks for a large site with thousands of URLs.

sections.h2: How Much Does Website Migration Cost in India?

paragraphs.text: How much does website migration cost in India? It depends on the number of pages and URLs, the type of move, the amount of content to transfer and whether the design is being rebuilt. A hosting move costs far less than a platform change with a new design.

Every project is quoted after a short audit, and the quote is fixed for the agreed scope. Our website migration services quotes list exactly what is included, from redirect mapping to four weeks of monitoring.

items.q: How do I move my website to a new domain?
items.a: Keep the old domain active, redirect every old URL to its matching new URL with permanent 301 redirects, verify both domains in Google Search Console, and use its Change of Address tool. Update your Google Business Profile, social profiles and important backlinks to point to the new domain.

items.q: Will my emails stop working during the move?
items.a: No, if DNS records are handled carefully. We copy your email records before the switch and test sending and receiving afterwards, so email keeps working throughout.

items.q: Do you keep my old content?
items.a: Yes. Every page with traffic, links or business value is carried over. Outdated or duplicate pages are reviewed with you, and any page we remove is redirected to the most relevant live page.

items.q: What is included in your website migration services after launch?
items.a: Four weeks of monitoring for crawl errors, indexing, rankings, traffic and leads, plus fixes for any issues we find. You receive a short report at the end comparing results with the pre-migration benchmark.
